name: Hussein Onn
role: Prime Minister of Malaysia from 1976 to 1981
contribution: A Malaysian lawyer and politician who was the third prime minister of Malaysia from 1976 to 1981.
legacy: He oversaw the implementation of admission quotas for Bumiputra students into institutions of higher education and made it a requirement to achieve a pass in Malay for Lower Certificate of Education and Malaysia Certificate of Education levels.

checks.lead: Hussein bin Onn (Jawi: حسين بن عون; 12 February 1922 – 29 May 1990) was a Malaysian lawyer and politician who was the third prime minister of Malaysia from 1976 to 1981.
